summary: United States 12 Month Natural Gas Fund, LP filed an 8-K disclosing that The Marygold Companies (TMC), its ultimate parent and sole shareholder of general partner USCF, agreed to be taken private by Madison Dearborn Partners in an all-cash transaction. TMC stock would leave the NYSE; closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to TMC stockholder approval, regulatory and change-of-control approvals. No per-share price, premium or break fee was disclosed. Watch for the eventual USCF business refocus and any impact on the fund's general partner.
